title: Training Notes: Wayfare Pass All Access Annual Members on Wayfare Bikes and Scooters Rides
content:
**The rule.** A rider who also holds a Wayfare Pass All Access Annual membership in trial, active or pending cancellation status gets the bike plan's Pass All Access free classic minutes on each classic bike ride and, where the bike plan's Pass All Access unlock waiver is set to yes, no unlock fee; other Wayfare Pass plans give no bike benefit. The plan's included minutes are used first and the Pass minutes after them.

The rule governs Wayfare Bikes and Scooters ride charges and overtime fees. The free-minute figure and the unlock waiver setting are those of the rider's Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plan.

**What establishes the membership.** The company's record of the rider's Wayfare Pass membership, held by the same rider as the bike plan, shows the Pass plan and its status, and that record as it stands before the ride is charged decides. The rider's own account of a membership does not take its place.

## Questions trainees raise, answered from the rule

**Which Wayfare Pass plan carries a bike benefit?**
Only Wayfare Pass All Access Annual. Other Wayfare Pass plans give no bike benefit.

**Which membership statuses carry the benefit?**
Trial, active and pending cancellation. These three are the statuses in which the benefit is borne; a membership in any other status does not meet the condition.

**What does the member receive?**
On each classic bike ride, the plan's Pass All Access free classic minutes on top of the plan's included minutes; and, where the plan's unlock waiver is set to yes, no unlock fee.

**Which minutes are used first?**
The plan's included minutes, then the Pass minutes.

## Membership table

| Wayfare Pass plan held | Membership status | Bike benefit |
|---|---|---|
| All Access Annual | trial | yes |
| All Access Annual | active | yes |
| All Access Annual | pending cancellation | yes |
| All Access Annual | any other status | no |
| any other Wayfare Pass plan | any status | no |

## Minute illustrations (hypothetical figures)

Assume, for illustration only, a bike plan with 40 included classic minutes and a Pass All Access figure of 25 minutes.

- A member in active status rides a classic bike for 55 minutes: the 40 plan minutes are used first, then 15 Pass minutes; no minute lies outside both allowances.
- The same member rides for 75 minutes: 40 plan minutes, then 25 Pass minutes, leaving 10 minutes outside both allowances.
- A rider whose Wayfare Pass plan is not All Access Annual rides for 75 minutes: only the 40 plan minutes apply, leaving 35 minutes outside the allowance.
